title: Label-conditional conformal prediction for multi-label 12-lead ECG diagnosis: code and results
description: Analysis notebook, configuration, result tables and figure scripts for a study of label-conditional (Mondrian) conformal prediction on PTB-XL with external validation on the Georgia and Chapman-Shaoxing cohorts of the PhysioNet/Computing in Cardiology Challenge 2021. The notebook downloads the public data from PhysioNet, verifies checksums and reproduces every table and figure.
